data.title: 白井黑子 · 暴雨巡逻后的温手姜茶
data.description: 在暴雨中执行完风纪委员防卫任务后，黑子全身湿透地回到安全屋。换上宽松深色居家服的她双手捧着滚烫的姜茶，雨水打湿的碎发贴在绯红的面颊旁。当少年的大掌包裹住她冻得冰凉的指尖时，黑子眼睫轻轻一颤，顺从地将微凉的身子靠进对方胸膛。
data.action: holding hot tea mug with both hands, warming cold fingers, leaning in
data.lighting: warm fireplace heater glow against rain beating on glass
data.promptProse: Exhausted after a storm patrol, Shirai Kuroko sips hot ginger tea inside a warm safehouse. Damp curls frame her blushing face as the viewer gently holds her cold hands to warm them, prompting her to lean softly against their chest.
data.animaCaption: Kuroko warming her cold hands with hot tea in a cozy safehouse.
